message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crime(s). Facts: Zhang (defendant) forged a document (a false official document) to hide a prior bribery record of a company employee, to facilitate the company's bid. This is falsification of official documents? Also possibly crime of providing false documents to public security? In Chinese criminal law, forging official documents is a crime: “伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪”. Also using false documents to obtain benefits could be “伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章罪”. Additionally, the act of forging a document to hide a bribery record may be considered “行贿”? Actually the company wants to hide the record to meet tender requirements; the act is not bribery but falsification. Also there is the earlier bribery record of employee but not relevant. The defendant printed a false document, spliced official seal, etc. That's forging a public security document. So crime: “伪造国家机关公文罪” (or “伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪”). The correct statutory name: "伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪". Also possibly "提供虚假材料罪"? But Chinese law: "提供虚假证明文件罪" maybe. However typical classification: forging official documents. So answer: [罪名]伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章<eoa>
